objective: GATE 3A preflight del frente Servidores + Conexiones + Comunicaciones + Robot Universal + Toast + Internacionalizacion. Auditar en solo lectura los 7 gaps certificados por Gate 2 para decidir diseño fisico exacto sin ejecutar DDL/DML: (1) entidad canonica de unidad y soporte timezone IANA/locale/moneda, (2) relacion capacidades↔sync, (3) modelo canonico de ejecuciones/evidencia/idempotencia, (4) RBAC activo, (5) fuente FX canonica, (6) identificadores externos genericos, (7) health real de conexiones separado de flags de configuracion. No leer valores secretos. No modificar repo/base/Production.

queries.name: unit_canonical_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (200) s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%Unidad%Negocio%' OR o.name LIKE '%Unidades%Negocio%' OR o.name LIKE '%Unidad%Operativa%' OR o.name LIKE '%Sucursal%') ORDER BY CASE WHEN o.name IN ('Unidades_Negocio','Sistema_UnidadesNegocio','Sistema_UnidadesNegocioPerfilDigital') THEN 0 ELSE 1 END,o.name

queries.name: unit_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (400) s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,c.column_id,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name IN ('Unidades_Negocio','Sistema_UnidadesNegocio','Sistema_UnidadesNegocioPerfilDigital','Sistema_TurnosOperativosUnidad') OR o.name LIKE '%Unidad%Negocio%') ORDER BY o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: unit_timezone_locale_currency_semantic_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (300) s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%Unidad%' OR o.name LIKE '%Empresa%') AND (c.name LIKE '%timezone%' OR c.name LIKE '%zona%horaria%' OR c.name LIKE '%iana%' OR c.name LIKE '%locale%' OR c.name LIKE '%idioma%' OR c.name LIKE '%language%' OR c.name LIKE '%moneda%' OR c.name LIKE '%currency%' OR c.name LIKE '%pais%' OR c.name LIKE '%country%') ORDER BY o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: capability_sync_candidate_objects
queries.sql: SELECT s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND ((o.name LIKE '%Capacidad%' AND o.name LIKE '%Sync%') OR (o.name LIKE '%Version%' AND o.name LIKE '%Sync%') OR (o.name LIKE '%Sistema%' AND o.name LIKE '%Sync%') OR (o.name LIKE '%Conexion%' AND o.name LIKE '%Sync%')) ORDER BY o.name

queries.name: capability_sync_candidate_columns
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (400) s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,c.name AS column_name,t.name AS data_type,c.max_length,c.is_nullable FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id=o.object_id JOIN sys.types t ON t.user_type_id=c.user_type_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (c.name LIKE '%Capacidad%' OR c.name LIKE '%Sync%' OR c.name LIKE '%CodigoSync%' OR c.name LIKE '%SistemaTipo%' OR c.name LIKE '%Version%') AND (o.name LIKE 'Sistema_%' OR o.name LIKE 'Servidores_%') ORDER BY o.name,c.column_id

queries.name: capability_sync_fk_graph
queries.sql: SELECT ps.name AS parent_schema,pt.name AS parent_table,pc.name AS parent_column,fk.name AS fk_name,rs.name AS ref_schema,rt.name AS ref_table,rc.name AS ref_column FROM sys.foreign_keys fk JOIN sys.foreign_key_columns fkc ON fkc.constraint_object_id=fk.object_id JOIN sys.tables pt ON pt.object_id=fkc.parent_object_id JOIN sys.schemas ps ON ps.schema_id=pt.schema_id JOIN sys.columns pc ON pc.object_id=pt.object_id AND pc.column_id=fkc.parent_column_id JOIN sys.tables rt ON rt.object_id=fkc.referenced_object_id JOIN sys.schemas rs ON rs.schema_id=rt.schema_id JOIN sys.columns rc ON rc.object_id=rt.object_id AND rc.column_id=fkc.referenced_column_id WHERE pt.name IN ('Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Servidores_Conexiones') OR rt.name IN ('Sistema_Capacidades','Sistema_Sync_Catalogo','Sistema_VersionesSistemas','Servidores_Conexiones') ORDER BY pt.name,fk.name,fkc.constraint_column_id

queries.name: execution_evidence_candidates
queries.sql: SELECT TOP (250) s.name AS schema_name,o.name AS object_name,o.type_desc FROM sys.objects o JOIN sys.schemas s ON s.schema_id=o.schema_id WHERE o.is_ms_shipped=0 AND (o.name LIKE '%Ejecucion%' OR o.name LIKE '%Execution%' OR o.name LIKE '%Evidencia%' OR o.name LIKE '%Evidence%' OR o.name LIKE '%SyncRun%' OR o.name LIKE '%Sync_Log%' OR o.name LIKE '%SyncLog%' OR o.name LIKE '%Importacion%' OR o.name LIKE '%Bitacora%Sync%') ORDER BY o.name
